Steffen Grabert, steffen.grabert@tum.de

TUM student. Python for data, ML and finance; TypeScript for web and

# AGENTS.md

Rules for AI coding agents in this repo. Humans follow them too.

Hackathon repo, EHL Grand Finale, Munich, 10 to 11 Oct 2026. Code freeze and Live Final Sunday
12:00. Working agent first, polish second.

## Rules

- Do not preserve backward compatibility. Remove obsolete paths instead of adding layers,
  fallbacks or migrations.
- Choose the simplest implementation that fully meets the current requirement. No speculative
  abstractions, configuration or indirection.
- Grow in layers on a product that already works. Never trade a working agent for unfinished
  complexity.
- Keep components modular and concerns separated.
- Read `arena_kit` (in `.venv`) before writing a helper: cost function, quote parsing, data lookup
  and runners exist. We wrap the kit, never patch it. Guide:
  https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/tree/main/starter-kit
- Never commit secrets. Keys live in `.env`. Never print, log or paste the arena key anywhere.
- All changes go through a PR against `main`, reviewed by one teammate. Branch `<firstname>/<topic>`.
  Agents may commit, push their branch and `gh pr create`; never push to `main`, force-push or merge.
- Run `uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check .` before every PR.
- No em-dashes in prose or copy. Be terse: after an action, state what changed in three lines.

## The challenge

We are the purchasing team of Hollerau Pumpenwerke. Our agent negotiates by e-mail with Tacto's
supplier bots (LLM personas with hidden economics) and closes one term sheet per case, or walks.

- **Score** per case: `(C_open - C_deal) / (C_open - C_best)`, clipped to 0..1. C is total cost
  over the horizon (price, uncovered need, payment, freight, lead time, quality, tooling, index
  clause, relationship charge), computed exactly by `arena_kit.total_cost`. No deal scores the
  alternative (0 if none). A broken must-have scores 0.
- **Live Final**: five waves of hidden cases, 8 minutes each, a wave's cases in parallel. Wave
  score = mean case score x 100; total = sum. New suppliers; up to a third mix supplier and case
  types practice never shows; some cite the Sunday 08:00 data release.

**Hard rules, breaking one can disqualify us:**
- No human in the loop during the final. The runner starts before 12:00 and is left alone.
- Agent code never calls `/v1/events`, `/v1/events/stream`, `/screen`, `/v1/screen`,
  `/leaderboard`, `/v1/leaderboard`, `/results`, `/v1/results`.
- One key per team. No attacks on the arena or other teams (prompt-injecting bots counts).
- The final runs the commit we submit at 12:00. No pushes after that.

**Hard limits:**
- 60 s per message per thread from the supplier's reply; three timeouts in a row end the thread.
- 10 messages per thread, up to 3 term sheets per message, every sheet carries every `negotiable`
  field.
- Max 3 claim checks per message, one per sentence, ID and figure in the same sentence. A wrong
  figure or unknown ID is `contradicted` and costs trust.
- 10 calls/s and 10 open sessions per key.
- **Practice quota: 200 sessions per rolling 24 h for the whole team.** Sandbox (`case:D01`,
  `case:D02`) and the local simulator are free.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `docs/learnings.md` | **read first**: what we know about the arena, suppliers and data, with evidence |
| `docs/design.md` | the agent we are building: modules, data, policy, build order |
| `docs/challenge.md`, `api.md`, `submission.md` | Tacto's brief, API and cost formula, hand-in (upstream copies) |
| `buyer/policy.py`, `runner.py` | the price engine: per-thread policy and the loop that plays a case (`docs/design.md`, Implemented) |
| `buyer/economics.py`, `claims.py`, `personas.py`, `writer.py`, `llm.py` | C and term planning, claim bank, persona signals, e-mail and model paragraph |
| `buyer/cli.py` | `buyer play`, `buyer run`, `buyer pull` |
| `tests/` | end to end against `arena-sim`, no network, no model |
| `exports/` | Saturday probe sessions as CSV/JSONL; schema in `exports/README.md` |
| `analysis/explore.py` | data package exploration: profiles, persona signals, report page |
| `data/package/` | the data package (gitignored); Sunday also `data/release-sunday/` |
| `logs/sessions/<set>/` | finished sessions with trace and back office (gitignored; Saturday's committed with `-f`) |
| `logs/runs/`, `logs/practice-v*.log` | our decisions per move (anchor, terms, claims, prices) and the practice run logs |

The MCP server `arena-data` (`.mcp.json`) gives SQL, ID lookup and documents over the package.

## Commands

```sh
uv sync                                         # install (Python 3.12)
uv run arena data                               # data package into data/
uv run arena me                                 # key works? quota left?
uv run buyer play case:D01 -v                   # sandbox: free
uv run buyer play case:P01 -v                   # practice: costs 1 of the team's 200
uv run buyer run --set practice --parallel 10   # all hosted practice cases: costs 10
uv run buyer pull --set practice                # finished sessions -> logs/sessions/
uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package   # local API, scripted supplier
uv run --with pandas python analysis/explore.py # data package -> analysis/out/
```

`--agent naive` plays the kit's baseline instead of ours.

## Working on the negotiation agent

- **Code owns numbers, the model owns words.** Every binding value (sheet, accept, walk away) is
  computed or checked in code with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`; every figure in an e-mail
  comes from code next to its data ID.
- **Never accept** a sheet that breaks a must-have or costs more than the alternative. Price
  unstated fields at the supplier's standard terms (`arena_kit.docs.standard_terms`).
- **Read the supplier.** What moves it is in the data (call notes, letters, news, quote remarks,
  payment history, scorecards). Trade what is cheap for us for what it values.
- **Score every lever per case.** The same term helps in one case and hurts in the next
  (coverage, payment days, start date, index clause, contract length).
- **Generalise.** No logic keyed on case or supplier IDs; runtime knowledge from the data package
  is fine if it works for unseen suppliers.
- **Don't leak** urgency, budget, a missing alternative or the target price.
- **Every model call has a hard timeout** well under 60 s, and the move still goes out if it
  fails. Measure latency per move.

## The learning loop

its notes, letters, quote remarks and news (the package and the Sunday release alike), and from
those its cost of money. Unknown suppliers (not in the package, e.g. the sandbox) get the neutral
profile; their own e-mails are scanned for the same traits as they arrive (`signals_in`)."""

import re

# One or two fixed phrases per trait in the generated texts, widened to the word forms seen across
# the whole package (restructuring programme, lowered its rating, "nickel and alloys forward").
SIGNALS = {
    "cash_need": r"pay earlier|bank is watching|cash and the banks|within 10 days|under pressure"
    r"|restructur\w*|short-time work|lower\w* (its |their )?rating|cash is tight|we like fast payers"
    r"|negotiat\w+ with (its|their) banks|lowers our margin|loss-making|liquidity|waiting for cash",
    "spare_capacity": r"second shift has been on hold|take additional parts|looks for new customers"
    r"|free (machine )?capacity|keep (the|our) machines (busy|running)",
    "capacity_full": r"order intake is very strong|binding 12-month commitment"
    r"|cannot confirm your full forecast|fully booked|allocat\w+ (volumes|in line)|factory is super busy"
    r"|high capacity utili[sz]ation|prioriti[sz]e customers with firm",
    "open_book": r"walk (us|you) through (their|our) calculation",
    "stale_costing": r"not followed (his|its|their) material|own spreadsheet",
    "partnership_2022": r"kept supplying at the old price",
    "reference_customer": r"important reference customer",
    "approval_2pct": r"above 2 ?% need the approval|pricing committee",
    "deprioritising_us": r"reviewing small accounts|not strategic|reorganising our range"
    r"|supply from stock only|sharpens its focus|focus on customers with volume",
    "price_frozen": r"no room on price|not discounted|price list applies to all|discounts not possible"
    r"|frozen all price reductions",
    "hedged": r"bought (their|our) [\w ,]{1,40} forward|covered at fixed prices|material covered until"
    r"|secures power prices|hedged",
    "complains_late_pay": r"invoices are overdue",
}
# Cost of money per year by owner type (seen in practice: groups 4 to 7 %, family firms 7 to 8.5 %,
# founder-run job shops 12 to 17 %); a cash need adds to it.
RATE = {"group": 0.05, "private": 0.07, "family": 0.075, "founder": 0.12}
DEFAULT_RATE = 0.07


def signals_in(text):
    return sorted(k for k, pat in SIGNALS.items() if re.search(pat, text or "", re.I))


def supplier_texts(pkg, sid):
    """Every text about this supplier: its letters, call and meeting notes and news, from the
    package and the Sunday release (both reach `ids` and `document`), plus its quote remarks."""
    texts = []
    for ref in pkg.ids("doc:") + pkg.ids("news:"):
        row = pkg.lookup(ref) or {}
        if row.get("supplier") != sid and row.get("supplier_id") != sid:
            continue
        try:
            texts.append(pkg.document(ref))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a row without a readable file: its headline still counts
            texts.append(" ".join(str(v) for k, v in row.items() if k in ("title", "headline", "body", "subject")))
    try:
        texts += [r.get("remarks") or "" for r in pkg.query("SELECT remarks FROM quotes WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))]
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite
        pass
    return texts


def profile(pkg, sid):
    """{owner_type, country, category, signals, rate, warm}; neutral when the package does not know it."""
    out = {"owner_type": None, "country": None, "category": None, "signals": [], "rate": DEFAULT_RATE, "warm": True}
    if pkg is None or not pkg.lookup(sid):
        return out
    try:
        sup = pkg.query("SELECT country, category, skonto_days, skonto_pct FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?", (sid,))
        intel = pkg.query("SELECT owner_type, staff FROM supplier_intel WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite: neutral
        return out
    sig = signals_in("\n".join(supplier_texts(pkg, sid)))
    owner = intel[0]["owner_type"] if intel else None
    rate = RATE.get(owner, DEFAULT_RATE)
    if "cash_need" in sig:
        rate += 0.05
    if sup and sup[0].get("skonto_pct") and sup[0].get("skonto_days"):
        # a cash discount of s % for paying d days early is worth s / d * 360 % a year to it
        days_early = max(1, 30 - int(sup[0]["skonto_days"]))
        rate = max(rate, min(0.2, sup[0]["skonto_pct"] / 100 * 360 / max(days_early, 10) / 2))
    out.update(
        owner_type=owner,
        country=sup[0]["country"] if sup else None,
        category=sup[0]["category"] if sup else None,
        signals=sig,
        rate=round(rate, 3),
        warm=owner in (None, "family", "founder", "private"),
    )
    return out

"""`buyer` command line: play one case or a whole set with our agent, and pull finished sessions
(result, trace with the supplier's reasons, back office) into logs/ for the learning loop."""

import argparse
import functools
import json
import logging
import os
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

from arena_kit import ArenaClient, ArenaError, RemoteTable, play, play_all
from arena_kit.cli import load_env, summary
from arena_kit.play import hosted, play_waves

from . import llm, runner
from .agent import AGENTS, load_package, naive_factory

LOGS = Path("logs/sessions")


def pull(client, set_):
    """Save every ended session of a set that has its trace to logs/sessions/<set>/, once."""
    out = LOGS / set_
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    saved = 0
    for s in client.sessions(set_):
        path = out / f"{s['case_id'].split(':')[-1]}_{s['session_id']}.json"
        if s["status"] != "ended" or path.exists():
            continue
        state = client.session(s["session_id"])
        if not (state.get("result") or {}).get("trace"):  # final: the trace comes after the final
            continue
        try:
            state["backoffice"] = client.backoffice(s["session_id"])
        except ArenaError:
            state["backoffice"] = None
        path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        saved += 1
    print(f"{saved} new sessions in {out}")


def main(argv=None):
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="buyer")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    verbose = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)  # -v also after the command
    verbose.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    verbose.add_argument("--no-llm", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS, help="template e-mails only")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser = functools.partial(sub.add_parser, parents=[verbose])
    data = {"default": os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA"), "help": "data package folder"}
    p = sub.add_parser("play", help="play one case")
    p.add_argument("case_id")
    p.add_argument("--agent", default="buyer", choices=AGENTS)
    p.add_argument("--data", **data)
    r = sub.add_parser("run", help="play every playable case of a set in parallel; final: wave by wave")
    r.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox", "final"])
    r.add_argument("--agent", default="buyer", choices=AGENTS)
    r.add_argument("--data", **data)
    r.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8, help="cases at once (at most 10)")
    r.add_argument("--waves", type=int, default=5, help="final: stop after this many waves have closed")
    r.add_argument("--cases", help="practice or sandbox: only these cases, e.g. P01,P08")
    s = sub.add_parser("pull", help="save finished sessions with trace and back office to logs/sessions/")
    s.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox", "final"])
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.no_llm = getattr(args, "no_llm", False)
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
        format="%(asctime)s %(message)s",
        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
    )
    client = ArenaClient()

    if args.cmd == "pull":
        return pull(client, args.set)
    naive = args.agent == "naive"
    pkg = None if naive else load_package(args.data)
    complete = None if naive or args.no_llm else llm.complete_from_env()
    if args.cmd == "play":
        table = RemoteTable(client)
        try:
            if naive:
                result = play(table, args.case_id, naive_factory()())
            else:
                result = runner.play_case(table, args.case_id, pkg, complete=complete)
        except ArenaError as e:  # e.g. not hosted, the quota, a paused key: the arena says why
            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
        print(json.dumps(summary(result), indent=2))
        state = client.session(table.session_id)
        print(f"replay: {os.environ['ARENA_URL'].rstrip('/')}{state.get('replay_url')}")
        pull(client, state["set"])
    elif args.set == "final":  # no human in the loop: waits for each wave, plays it within its cap
        parallel = min(args.parallel, 10)
        if naive:
            out = play_waves(client, naive_factory(), args.waves, parallel)
        else:
            out = runner.play_waves(client, pkg, args.waves, parallel, complete=complete)
        for case_id, result in out.items():
            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
    else:
        ids = [c["case_id"] for c in hosted(client.cases(args.set))]
        if args.cases:
            ids = [i for i in ids if i.split(":")[-1] in args.cases.split(",")]
        parallel = min(args.parallel, 10)
        if naive:
            out = play_all(lambda: RemoteTable(client), ids, naive_factory(), parallel)
        else:
            out = runner.play_all(client, ids, pkg, parallel, complete=complete)
        for case_id, result in out.items():
            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
        scores = [r["score"] for r in out.values() if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("score") is not None]
        if scores:
            print(f"mean score: {100 * statistics.mean(scores):.1f} over {len(scores)} cases")
        pull(client, args.set)
    if client.practice_remaining is not None:
        print(f"practice sessions left today: {client.practice_remaining}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Hollerau Pumpenwerke - procurement data package v1.0.0

You are the purchasing team of Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, a fictional pump maker (start with
`company.md`). Everything is as of **2026-09-30**. Company data is synthetic; market series are real
open data (`ATTRIBUTION.md`). All company names are fictional; any match with a real company is
coincidental.

## Files
- `data/*.csv` - the master copy (UTF-8, comma, ISO dates, dot decimals); schema in `datapackage.json`.
- `world.sqlite` - the same tables in one SQLite file, generated from the CSVs.
- `facts.json` - every ID you can cite in a claim, with the values the arena checks.
- Prices are per `price_unit` (1, 100 or 1,000 pieces, kg or m), as the ERP states them; cases
  negotiate in the same unit.
- `company.md`, `SCORECARD.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `ATTRIBUTION.md`; contract texts in `contracts/`,
  letters, e-mails and notes in `correspondence/`.

## IDs
`<type>:<id>[@period]`, unique across the package, in the first column of each table: `sup:70110`,

| Table | Rows | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `suppliers` | 447 | Vendor master: the detailed suppliers (`detail = full`) and the long tail (`spend only`). |
| `supplier_intel` | 46 | Public face of each detailed supplier: register facts, filed turnover, credit index, audit. |
| `parts` | 60 | Material master of the detailed parts. |
| `sourcing` | 90 | Source list: approved suppliers per part, quota, tooling owner. |
| `price_conditions` | 339 | Price history per part and supplier (price per `price_unit`), with the event behind it. |
| `negotiation_history` | 300 | Past price events: renewals with asked and settled change. |
| `contracts` | 46 | Framework agreements (text in `contracts/`). |
| `contract_clauses` | 280 | Clauses of the framework agreements, incl. index clauses (`ctr:<no>#<clause>`). |
| `po_lines` | 5400 | Purchase order lines: requested and first confirmed date, price per `price_unit`. |
| `goods_receipts` | 5580 | Goods receipts per PO line (posting date, quantity). |
| `invoices` | 5578 | Supplier invoices with due and payment dates, cash discount taken. |
| `quality_notifications` | 1033 | Complaints against suppliers (QN), with 8D dates and recharged fees. |
| `scorecards` | 414 | Rolling 12-month supplier scorecards per quarter (method: `SCORECARD.md`). |

| `forecast_lines` | 8640 | Monthly quantities of each forecast snapshot. |

| `index_values` | 2258 | Monthly values of the market series (`idx:<series>@<YYYY-MM>`). |
| `cost_drivers` | 166 | The category team's estimate of each part's cost drivers (index series and weight). |
| `should_cost` | 28 | Bottom-up should-cost estimates for selected parts (`cost:<part>`). |
| `news` | 39 | Press items about suppliers and markets. |
| `documents` | 208 | Letters, e-mails, meeting and call notes (text in `correspondence/`). |

```
suppliers 1-n sourcing n-1 parts          parts 1-n price_conditions n-1 suppliers
suppliers 1-1 supplier_intel, 1-n contracts 1-n contract_clauses

```
